# CONSTRUCTED INPUT, NOT A CAPTURE. No EC was read to make this file; every
# byte below was written by hand. See README.md.
# Shape: `ecrw.py dump 0x0400 0x0060` as §3's step 6 takes it, and the
# companion of the `...-moved-battery-before-0400.txt` beside it. It differs at
# 0x0434, 0x0435, 0x0436, 0x0438, 0x0439, 0x043E, 0x0448, 0x0449, 0x044C and
# 0x044F, and at nothing else, so the whole-block read over this pair puts six
# named bytes in its "other addresses that differ" bucket and the two
# temperatures in the context one. 0x0434/0x0435 and 0x0438/0x0439 step up by a
# little and the two derived bytes step with them; 0x0436 is the capture's own
# last new value for it (0xC0) and 0x044C its first (0x71, the first of its 247
# rows), the two values
# evidence/ec-watch/2026-09-18-profile-switch-0400-07ff.csv records for those
# two addresses. Every value here is invented, as every value in the before
# dump beside it is. Not a prediction that a battery reads this, or that a
# fixed load is what moved any of it.
